description:
The 409th CSB, RCO Wiesbaden, is publishing this presolicitation notice for the purchase of a tractor for airfield maintenance. This requirement will be solicited via SAM.gov on or before 18 May 2026.

All vendors with questions, comments, or interest in providing the equipment specified in the documentation should submit their interest via email to:

  • Sebastian Gotzmer: sebastian.gotzmer.ln@army.mil

  • Aaron M. Ritter: aaron.m.ritter.civ@army.mil

Note: Please include the reference identifier "W912CM-26-Q-A017 – DPW Airfield Maintenance Tractor" in the subject line of all communications.
